chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about a man who missed one rak'ah with the Imam during the days of Tashriq. He said: 'He completes the prayer and says Takbir.'

key_terms.أَيَّامَ التَّشْرِيقِ: The days of Tashriq (the 11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they miss one rak'ah of the Eid prayer with the Imam?
ai.summary: This ruling from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the procedural validity of joining the Eid prayer late, emphasizing that the missed rak'ah is completed individually before the final Takbir. It reflects the Shia jurisprudential view that the Eid prayer structure allows for flexible integration of latecomers, ensuring the congregational integrity is maintained even with partial participation. This specific instruction highlights the practical application of prayer completion rules during the festive days of Tashriq.
